name: cardgame-art-briefs-spatial-race-identity
title: Art briefs for the Spatial Race Identity Set (3 cards)
pitch: Write the missing art briefs for design/cards/spatial-race-identity-set.md's 3 cards, closing the spatial-race-identity slice of DESIGN-READINESS.md's Open Gap 1.
why_now: DESIGN-READINESS.md Open Gap 1 names this hole explicitly and tools/composite-card-art.js already surfaces it live via its own 'no art brief for "<name>"' warning; the wormhole-closure-cards half of the same gap is already in-flight as the sibling unit cardgame-art-briefs-wormhole-closure, leaving this 3-card set the one piece of Gap 1 nothing yet targets.
expected_outcome: design/cards/art-briefs.md gains exactly 3 new '###' sections — 'Preemptive Survey', 'Unbound Passage', 'Chokepoint Garrison' — each with a Palette line naming its card's Fount color, a 'Key visual elements:' list of >=2 card-specific bullets, and a Composition line with a rectangular/landscape aspect ratio; running tools/composite-card-art.js (mock mode) no longer prints 'no art brief for' for any of these 3 names.
intent: design/cards/art-briefs.md documents an art brief for every card in most shipped card sets, but design/cards/spatial-race-identity-set.md's 3 cards (Preemptive Survey — Panoptic Concord, Unbound Passage — Starweave Communion, Chokepoint Garrison — Cindral Reach) have none. DESIGN-READINESS.md's Open Gap 1 names this hole explicitly, and tools/composite-card-art.js already surfaces it live via its own 'no art brief for "<name>"' warning on every run. Add one brief per card, following the established format every prior art-briefs unit has used (Palette, Subject/Scene, Key visual elements, Composition), naming the Fount-driven palette color for each card's own Cost line (Signal→Cyan, Tangle→Violet, Mass→Ash-grey per card-anatomy.md's Fount identity table) and a Composition line citing the Art Window's rectangular/landscape shape and aspect ratio — so these 3 cards can go through the compositing pipeline like every other shipped card set.

criteria.text: design/cards/art-briefs.md contains exactly one '###' section titled verbatim 'Preemptive Survey', one titled 'Unbound Passage', and one titled 'Chokepoint Garrison' (the 3 card titles in design/cards/spatial-race-identity-set.md), with no pre-existing brief sections removed, renamed, or altered

The 'Preemptive Survey' brief's Palette line names Cyan (Signal), the 'Unbound Passage' brief's Palette line names Violet (Tangle), and the 'Chokepoint Garrison' brief's Palette line names Ash-grey (Mass), matching each card's own Cost line per card-anatomy.md's Fount identity table

Each of the 3 new briefs has a 'Key visual elements:' list of at least 2 bullets that share at least 2 significant words with that card's own Type line/Rules text, and none of the bullets use generic filler phrases like 'epic composition' or 'stunning artwork'

Each of the 3 new briefs has a 'Composition:' line naming the Art Window's rectangular/landscape shape and an explicit aspect ratio (e.g. '5:3'), consistent with card-anatomy.md's Art Window description

Running tools/composite-card-art.js in its default (mock) mode no longer prints 'no art brief for "Preemptive Survey"', 'no art brief for "Unbound Passage"', or 'no art brief for "Chokepoint Garrison"'
